messages:
samir_s: Heads up — discovered that the canary rollout gate allows users with 'deploy_viewer' to trigger fallback via the ops UI. Repro steps and logs below. Possible RBAC mismatch between gatekeeper service and console. cc @olivia_p @maria_ops

olivia_p: noted. can you paste repro steps?

samir_s: steps:
1) login as user with role deploy_viewer
2) open /console/rollouts
3) click 'trigger fallback' on canary instance
4) request goes to /api/v1/rollouts/:id/fallback and returns 202
log snippet:
```
INFO 2024-11-03T14:22:11Z route=rollouts fallback requested by user=alice.deploy_viewer id=cr-123 allowed=true policy_check=skipped
```
policy_check=skipped is suspicious.

maria_ops: that sounds bad — fallback should require 'rollout_admin' or 'ops_release' role. timeline?

samir_s: I tested with a staging token. It looks like gatekeeper uses 'action:*' predicate but console passes 'permission:trigger-fallback' — mismatch in mapping. Gatekeeper rejects in other endpoints but not this one.

olivia_p: might be from the 2025 refactor of role mapping (PR #4231). @ben_product do we want fallback available to product managers? we had a discussion.

ben_product: product shouldn't be able to do fallback in prod. only SRE/release to avoid accidental rollbacks.

samir_s: quick mitigation — add a server-side hardcheck for role 'ops_release' until we fix mapping. Also add audit log entries to KMS-backed audit log (we currently redact user id) — need full user id for investigations.

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-1103 — label: security, severity: medium. Assigned to samir_s, maria_ops.

maria_ops: I'll open a hotfix branch. plan: 1) add hardcheck + unit tests 2) push canary 3) enable tighter audit logs (non-redacted id) to KMS HSM with retention 90d 4) roll out.

olivia_p: add a feature-flag so we can revert quickly. also run ACL integration test across all rollout endpoints.

samir_s: will draft PR and include link to failing E2E. PR coming in ~30m.

ben_product: thx. if you need an emergency rollback policy, tag me.

oncall-bot: paging @oncall — possible access-control regression. escalation policy triggered.

samir_s: follow-ups: 1) check PR #4231 for role mapping table, 2) add regression tests to CI, 3) run audit on last 7 days for similar events.

maria_ops: I ran a quick grep, saw 3 similar 'policy_check=skipped' for different rollout ids in the last 5 days. adding to INC notes.

olivia_p: great. Thanks team. will monitor after hotfix.
